hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -q '\.dart$'; then dart format $(echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ',' ' '); fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -q '\.dart$' && grep -l '@riverpod' $(echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ',' ' ') 2>/dev/null; then dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs; fi
